text:
Type: round pink tufted cushion
Use: on a sofa, an armchair, a bed or the floor; bedroom, living room
Style: retro, glam, bohemian
Materials: soft plush velour fabric, embroidered rose button at the center
Colors: pale pink, black dots, red and green rose
Shape: round pouf-like cushion gathered into deep pleats toward a center tuft, covered in small black polka dots, thick and plump
Feel: sweet, playful, soft, romantic
Goes with: white or blush textiles, light wood, brass accents; romantic bedrooms, retro or glam rooms
